original_test_intent: Inject an MP5 uncorrectable error at the intended socket/CCD/index, verify immediate warm reset and a fresh MP5-attributed persistent record, then prove the target CCD and firmware-managed services recover after boot.
original_method: Approve the MP5-to-CCD map and full tuple; baseline reset/BERT and controller state; inject once under OOB console; capture reset/firmware/boot intervals; decode fresh MP5 UCE evidence; verify cores, NUMA, memory, sensors and power/thermal controls; restore thresholds, debug settings and HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE approves the MP5 CCD tuple and reset behavior, executes one UCE under independent console, recovers compute and firmware services and restores platform state.
required_inputs: Vendor semantics for errormode2, CCD0, mcapolling0 and errortype1
FFE threshold, debug-disable and SyncFlood relevance plus raw restoration values
Fresh MP5-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL and reset-cause fields
Reset, firmware, boot and OS-report deadlines
CCD compute, memory and SMU sensor/power/thermal recovery limits, aborts and OOB restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated thermally safe SUT with independent BMC/serial console and boot-loop recovery
Preserve reset cause and durable logs before approved clearing
Inject one mapped tuple once and do not retry automatically after reset
Abort on wrong source, missing reset, boot failure, stale evidence, absent cores/NUMA, MCA growth or controller/sensor loss
Restore all RAS/HDT settings and confirm stable workload and controls
agent_execution_scope: Validate tuple, reset policy, persistent oracle, deadlines and recovery plan
Collect read-only raw settings, OOB/BERT/CPER/SEL, CPU/NUMA/memory and firmware-service health
Do not choose target, alter BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve reset/durable evidence and health criteria

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic MP5/SMU/uncorrected text cannot prove CCD0/index0 attribution, distinguish stale BERT or show the controller recovered after reset.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After topology and reset-evidence approval, run one MP5 UCE with uninterrupted OOB capture and correlate fresh MP5 source fields to bounded reboot plus compute/controller health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: socket0, errormode2, CCD0, mcapolling0, errorindex0, errortype1, immediate reset, FFE threshold, three OS families and 15/20-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute one mapped MP5 UCE with fresh persistent evidence, bounded reset/boot and post-event CCD plus firmware-service validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical coverage, sticky-evidence hygiene, time limits, compute/controller recovery and raw rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful reboot and generic BERT line cannot prove the intended MP5/CCD source or full recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The injection may cause repeated reset, remove compute resources or degrade power/thermal management.

project_override_considerations: For multiple CCDs or sockets, document the approved coverage matrix; never treat CCD0/socket0 as universally representative without an engineering decision. The CE Criteria line is retained only as alternate-severity text.
expected_evidence: MP5 socket/CCD/index topology and approved tuple
Exact injection and OOB reset/firmware/boot timeline
Fresh MP5-specific UCE MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL plus reset-cause transition
Recovered cores, NUMA, memory workload, sensors and power/thermal controls

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The MP5 UCE title, errortype1, immediate reset and BERT branch align. Remaining gaps are platform-specific semantics and incomplete acceptance/recovery details rather than contradictory source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended MP5 UCE and literal command are clear. Static review completes while execution awaits platform decisions.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 84 Wistron-System RAS-00804-V003: map MP5 to socket/CCD/core/NUMA and define smupsp errormode2/CCD0/mcapolling0/errorindex0/errortype1 semantics; specify FFE/debug/SyncFlood relevance, fresh MP5-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL and reset-cause evidence, reset/firmware/boot/OS deadlines, compute/memory/sensor/power/thermal recovery, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds die-specific durable attribution and verifies both compute and firmware-control recovery after the expected MP5 reset.
independent_technical_reasoning: MP5 UCE is targeted at a CCD-scoped firmware path, so a platform may reboot while losing part of its compute topology or management telemetry. BERT must be proven fresh and associated with MP5/index0, not merely present after boot. Continuous OOB timing plus core/NUMA and sensor/control checks closes the gap between reset completion and actual recovery.
